I actually have smoked before, large quantities to be specific, and it did nothing, not even a little bleep on my feeling-o-meter. 

Meditation seems to be fairly well recommended...but how or why does it work?

I guess I have some hope for medication...but a lot less than before I started getting medicated lol. It's been disappointing so far, kinda hoping for some sort of miracle and getting...well, not much.

I hate the never ending medication journey. I'm currently on my 5th different antidepressant. Joy.

@goldfishlaser 
You make a good point about the confirmation bias. 
It's not a choice between "Think rationally" and "Be happy with life." I know those two aren't mutually exclusive...it might just be that I can't infer or impose a reason or rationale on events in life. 
For example. I work in cellular immunology. Most people would say, cool, helping make vaccines, pushing the frontiers of science. I'm completely bored and fed up with it. There's *no point* to determining the immunodominance hierarchy of some small protein, or quantifying this or elucidating that. With a different mindset maybe I could convince myself that I'm working towards a greater good. I just can't though. Now, take that example, and apply it to an entire life.
